of.needed: whether strict-validate-path-type configuration option is explicitly enabled in ingress-nginx

original.statement: cert-manager 1.18.0 changes ACME HTTP01 Ingress challenge routes to use PathType `Exact` instead of `ImplementationSpecific`, which is incompatible with ingress-nginx versions that have the buggy `strict-validate-path-type` validation enabled by default (>= 1.12.0).

of.needed: whether any ACME Issuer/ClusterIssuer uses an HTTP01 Ingress-based solver whose challenge Ingress is handled by ingress-nginx
whether ingress-nginx strict-validate-path-type is enabled (default on in >=1.12.0 unless explicitly disabled; off by default in 1.8.x-1.11.x unless explicitly enabled)

corrected.statement: Exposed: environments that solve ACME HTTP01 challenges with Ingress-based solvers on ingress-nginx >=1.8.0 with strict-validate-path-type enabled (on by default from 1.12.0). There, the admission webhook denies the challenge Ingress.

decision.reason: [ev-110340e9c914] says the failure happens only when cert-manager presents an ACME HTTP01 Ingress-based challenge through ingress-nginx >=1.8.0 with `strict-validate-path-type` enabled. That option is on by default in >=1.12.0, but nothing in the evidence says it cannot be turned off. The proposed `gvk-in-use Ingress` leaf is the wrong test: it matches any environment with Ingress manifests, and it misses environments whose only Ingresses are the ones cert-manager creates for challenges. The >=1.12.0 branch is also too broad, because it flags installs that have turned the option off. The option is a static ingress-nginx setting rather than runtime behaviour, so the gap is environment visibility.
